claim: An internal FBI email released in the DOJ Epstein Files Transparency Act production — the "RE: NTOC Names" triage summary of August 7, 2025 (Data Set 10, EFTA01660651) — logs roughly a dozen tips phoned or submitted to the FBI National Threat Operations Center under the Epstein child-sex-trafficking case file (50D-NY-3027571), each with a disposition and a criminal-history check. The tips range widely: a caller alleging she was forced as a young teen to perform a sex act on Donald Trump decades ago; a caller naming an alleged former Epstein personal assistant and listing party guests including Bill Clinton and Donald Trump; a caller describing assaults at Epstein's New York residence; the Trump-golf-course allegations recorded separately (the Rancho Palos Verdes ring and the Robin Leach "19th hole" claims); a caller claiming to possess films of prominent men; a caller alleging a teenage modeling-recruitment approach by Ghislaine Maxwell; and a limousine driver recounting a 1995 Trump airport ride. The document is a triage log, not a set of findings, and its recorded dispositions are mostly inconclusive or negative: "Lead was sent to [the Washington] Office to conduct interview," "2 voicemails left, no response received," "Voicemail left, no response," "no probative information," a complainant who promised corroborating email that "no email received," and — for the golf-course tipster — "Complainant was spoken to and deemed not credible. Additional research showed 3 separate incidents involving police which requested mandatory psychiatric evaluations." Several entries note criminal-history matches for the callers (a 1987 assault-and-battery arrest; a 1998 burglary/assault/grand-theft and 2007 theft; a 2012 harassing-communication/assault).

notes: Group-B documentary record from the corpus sweep prompted by reel DZdu3dZR_O0. Verified facts: this triage spreadsheet exists in our EFTA corpus (DS10 EFTA01660651) and records the FBI's handling of ~12 NTOC tips to the Epstein case file. The value is context — the golf-course/Robin-Leach tip (2021-trump-golf-ntoc-tip-001) is one row among many, and the document's own dispositions show the tip-line received many lurid uncorroborated Trump/Epstein allegations that the FBI mostly could not advance (no response to follow-up, no probative information, one 'deemed not credible' with a psychiatric-evaluation history; a single lead referred for interview). These are unverified third-party tips; the triage log is not a finding of fact. PII discipline: complainant names are redacted in the source and kept redacted here; alleged private third parties named by tipsters and any alleged minor-victim names are deliberately NOT reproduced — only the public figures the tips themselves reference (Trump, Clinton, Epstein, Maxwell) are named, and only as the content of unverified allegations.
